# Neuromorphic_Spectral_Processing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of spectral-domain computations (e.g., Fourier or wavelet transforms) within neuromorphic hardware to emulate brain-like frequency-based processing. Aligns with iNEST's goal of energy-efficient, real-time sensory processing by leveraging spectral sparsity and biological plausibility.
